product_family: Canva Social is a social media design and content management feature within the Canva design platform. Includes social media content creation tools, content planner with scheduling, Magic Write AI caption generation, and brand kit management.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Canva has attained SOC2 Type II compliance, which demonstrates that the company has undergone independent audits of its security controls.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Canva is ISO 27001 certified. Canva will maintain an ISO 27001 certification, undergoing periodic external surveillance and recertification audits to ensure that its Information Security Management System (ISMS) meets the requirements of this standard.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Canva's Trust & Security Portal displays ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS, EU-US DPF, GDPR, CCPA, DSA, and VPAT compliance documents.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Canva has introduced tools and processes to ensure it complies with GDPR requirements. Additionally, Canva meets globally recognized security standards, including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: Canva's Trust & Security Portal displays compliance information for CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act).

certifications.name: DSA (Digital Services Act)
certifications.proof_quote: Canva displays Digital Services Act (DSA) compliance on its trust portal.

certifications.name: VPAT (Voluntary Product Accessibility Template)
certifications.proof_quote: Canva's Trust & Security Portal includes VPAT (Voluntary Product Accessibility Template) compliance documentation.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance found on Canva's trust center or security pages. While Canva holds healthcare/medical templates, no BAA (Business Associate Agreement) or HIPAA compliance documentation is publicly available.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management Systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on vendor domain. ISO 42001 is an emerging standard and Canva has not published any certification in this area as of July 2026.

privacy.ai_training_note: Free and Pro users: Canva analyzes user content and activity to train AI algorithms and models. Users can opt-out in privacy preferences under 'AI personalization settings'. Business, Enterprise, and Education accounts: Customer content is NOT used for AI training by default, and this setting cannot be enabled. Education students have explicit carve-out: student user content will not be used for AI training.
privacy.data_region: AWS data centers (primary US-based). Backups stored in geographically-separated location. Data transfers internationally protected with GDPR Standard Contractual Clauses and EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or higher for all data transmitted between customers and Canva application over public networks

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 or stronger for customer personal data stored on Canva servers

security.name: Data Centers
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS) with auto-scaling, multiple availability zones, 24x7 monitoring and support

security.name: Backup & Disaster Recovery
security.value: Backups stored in geographically-separated location from primary data centers

security.name: Security Governance
security.value: Chief Security Officer, Chief Privacy Officer, Chief Data Officer, and Information Security Committee (meets quarterly)

security.name: AI Safety Framework
security.value: Canva Shield: Safe, fair, and secure AI with indemnification for eligible enterprise customers in case of IP claims from AI-generated content

products.name: Canva Social (Content Planner & Design)
products.data_scope: User content (designs, videos, images), user metadata, usage analytics, search queries
products.notes: Social media content creation and planning tool. Features include drag-and-drop design, 30-second video/Reels creation, Brand Kit management, content scheduling and auto-posting, Magic Write AI captions, background removal, and analytics integration. Available on Free, Pro, Teams, Business, and Enterprise plans.

products.name: Canva (Core Platform)
products.data_scope: User designs, templates, media library, collaboration data, team/organization data
products.notes: Broader design platform that includes social media tools. Free tier, Pro subscription, Teams subscription, Business, and Enterprise tiers each with different compliance and data handling practices.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free with limited features) + subscription tiers (Pro, Teams, Business, Enterprise)
compare.trains_on_data: Varies by plan: Free/Pro/Teams yes (with opt-out); Business/Enterprise/Education no

flags: AI training default differs by plan tier: free/pro users' content is used for AI training (opt-out available), while enterprise/education users have explicit protection. Ensure AIFOXX displays this distinction clearly.
There is no evidence of HIPAA compliance. Canva is not HIPAA-certified and does not appear to offer BAAs; users in healthcare should not rely on Canva for HIPAA-regulated content.
ISO 42001 (AI governance): Not certified. Emerging standard not yet widely adopted.
Trust center returns 403 access errors on some pages (canva.com/trust/compliance), but public documentation and newsroom statements confirm certification status.
